comment: Table-driven pack for Partitions and inheritance. Shared project template; each scenario overlays one declarative file.

scenarios.description: apply partition.range with a native in-place operation
scenarios.comment: Covers PG-CAT-PRT-01::partition.range. Keep public.transition_anchor identity stable.

requiredMigrationPatterns.description: emits native DDL rather than recreating the anchor

forbiddenMigrationPatterns.description: does not replace the transition anchor
